VANTAGE.gloss: place or situation affording some advantage
VANTAGE.definition: Place or situation affording some advantage (especially a comprehensive view or commanding perspective).

AGENT.definition: An active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect.
AGENT.example: Their research uncovered new disease agents.

VEGAN.definition: A strict vegetarian; someone who eats no animal or dairy products at all.

AGATE.gloss: an impure form of quartz consisting of banded chalcedony
AGATE.definition: An impure form of quartz consisting of banded chalcedony; used as a gemstone and for making mortars and pestles.

AGAVE.gloss: tropical American plants with basal rosettes of fibrous sword-shaped leaves and…
AGAVE.definition: Tropical American plants with basal rosettes of fibrous sword-shaped leaves and flowers in tall spikes; some cultivated for ornament or for fiber.

GATE.gloss: a movable barrier in a fence or wall
GATE.definition: A movable barrier in a fence or wall.

GET.gloss: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
GET.definition: Come into the possession of something concrete or abstract.
GET.example: She got a lot of paintings from her uncle.

AGE.example: It was replaced because of its age.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

VAN.gloss: any creative group active in the innovation and application of new concepts and…
VAN.definition: Any creative group active in the innovation and application of new concepts and techniques in a given field (especially in the arts).

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

TEA.gloss: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
TEA.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.
TEA.example: Iced tea is a cooling drink.

TAG.gloss: attach a tag or label to
TAG.definition: Attach a tag or label to.

GEN.example: Give me the gen on your new line of computers.

TAN.gloss: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.
